ai_summary: AAVAS Financers Limited has announced an increase in its AFL Prime Lending Rate by 20 basis points, raising it from 17.70% to 17.90%, effective December 04, 2026. This strategic adjustment is expected to improve the company's net interest margin and profitability, likely reflecting a response to rising funding costs or a hardening interest rate environment. While beneficial for AAVAS, it will result in higher borrowing costs for customers with floating rate loans, and the relatively high absolute lending rate (17.90%) may indicate the company operates in a higher-risk borrower segment or faces a higher cost of capital.
